theme: Programming a robot with almost no memory
title: Almost-No-Memory Relay Courier
strategies: do-nothing / null controller: submit an empty rule table so every observation defaults to WAIT (reproduces the evaluator's floor baseline)

hardcode the visible grid: BFS the one fully-shown training grid on raw coordinates and encode its exact move sequence as a one-shot state chain (state i -> move i regardless of what generalizes); replays that grid almost perfectly and stalls at WAIT on every other grid

decode the given color code into a compact 2-mode reactive table: mode 0 reads phase0_code, stepping on the relay beacon switches to mode 1 which reads phase1_code -- identical performance on visible and held-out grids alike
the same reactive table plus deliberate slack/backtrack-margin tuning or redundant-but-harmless rule padding to explore the size-penalty trade-off without changing the core reactive insight
